An '''Abyssin grafting patch''', or '''AGP''', was a medical supply that used harvested regenerative cells from [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssins]] to promote rapid growth of new skin cells. They were manufactured by [[Kirgalis Pharmaceutical Exports]] using genetic material collected by agreement with a [[Unidentified Abyssin tribe|single Abyssin tribe]].<ref name="GFT" />
